A neural network in pure CSS

Draw a digit. A $arch network ($n_params integer weights) reads it using only @property, calc(), :has() and exp(). 0 bytes of JavaScript.

$grid_cells
Press and drag on the gridTap cells to paint them, any size, anywhere.
$score_rows

Inside the network

Every cell below is a CSS custom property, recomputed by the browser each time a pixel changes.

$pipeline
Your drawing is cropped, squared and resampled to 8×8, then passed through two ReLU layers. The winning digit is picked with clamp() masks and printed with a CSS counter. Trained on MNIST and font-rendered digits. More in pure CSS: latent space explorer · tic-tac-toe · rock paper scissors · connect four · live training · Source on GitHub.
